_comment: chainId/address pairs riskscreen.py treats as ~zero-volatility quote assets. Addresses are lowercased at load time. Edit this file (or point BSTOCKS_STABLECOIN_CONFIG at a different one) to add/remove entries -- no code change needed. An address NOT listed here is never presumed to be a stablecoin; it falls through to the stricter relative-volatility path instead.
